reviews.title: Great external GPU dock
reviews.comment: I bought this Minisforum external GPU dock to house a Nvidia RTX card, along with a power supply. Connection to the PC is via an Oculink cable that came with unit.  Attaching the power supply and the video card was very easy. You just plug them in. Connection speed is fine, as measured with a benchmark app.  The unit is turned on and off from the PC; very convenient. The whole setup works flawlessly and for $99, it is a good value.
reviews.author: Bob Galiatsatos

reviews.title: Great GPU dock
reviews.comment: Works great, all plug and play. No issues running it with Nvidia RTX 5 series cards. Being open air card stays pretty cool and quiet. Might want to consider shorter aftermarket cables to keep it looking neat and tidy. Excellent value for the money.
reviews.author: Jay

reviews.title: Plug and Play
reviews.comment:
I was worried I'd have to fiddle with the settings to get everything to talk to each other, but it fired right up and worked right out of the box once everything was wired up properly. Note I'm using another Minisforum as the base PC, so YMMV.
Hardware:
- Minisforum UM-890 Pro w/64gb of RAM
- Radeon RX 6950 XT
- MSI MAG 650w PSU
Software:
- Bazzite (that's it, OCulink handled the GPU same as it would on a desktop)
reviews.author: Zedd

reviews.title: Best move for my application
reviews.comment: Migrated to a mini pc and wanted to continue to use my 3 32" monitors. This is the perfect solution as it allowed me to use my card externally.
reviews.author: Dwight

reviews.title: GPU Will Be Loose
reviews.comment: No riser support bracket for the GPU. PCIe connection is wobbly and loose. I don't recommend if you plan to use for prolonged periods. Better to buy an enclosure with actual support for GPU stabilization.
reviews.author: Eric Whitney
